plugin.note: Mithril dragon strategy: draconic dragonbane target with 50% Earth-spell weakness. Bring full dragonfire protection; mithril dragons cannot be cannoned.

mechanics: Mithril dragons use melee, ranged, magic, and metallic dragonfire.
They are the only Metal dragon task variant that cannot be cannoned.
They can drop dragon full helm and chewed bones.
They have a 50% earth spell vulnerability and the draconic attribute.

methods.label: Dragonfire protection
methods.summary: Use full dragonfire protection and prepare for all three combat styles.
requiredOrKeyItems: Anti-dragon shield or defender depending on potion setup
steps: Access the Ancient Cavern after Barbarian Firemaking.
Use extended super antifire or shield plus antifire.
Expect melee, ranged, magic, and dragonfire attacks.

methods.label: Dragonbane or Earth
methods.summary: Use dragon hunter lance for melee or Tumeken's shadow/dragon hunter wand for Magic.
steps: Use dragon hunter lance, fang, or stab weapons for melee.
Use Tumeken's shadow, dragon hunter wand, or other strong Magic if using the earth weakness.
Use ranged dragonbane as an alternative.

styleOptions.label: Earth Magic
styleOptions.summary: Tumeken's shadow, dragon hunter wand, or other Magic setup using earth weakness.

styleOptions.label: Ranged dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter crossbow or ranged alternative.

body:
# Mithril dragon

Draconic dragonbane target with 50% Earth-spell weakness. Bring full dragonfire protection; mithril dragons cannot be cannoned.
